description: FlixOpt is a Python system-optimisation package based on components, buses and flows. It supports dispatch, investment, multi-period and stochastic formulations, with multiple objectives and result analysis. The provider is FlixOpt contributors. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository states MIT and documents the bundled HiGHS solver. Other optional solvers have separate terms. Limitations: Results depend on model structure and assumptions. Claimed performance and example reproducibility were not tested. For simulation it supports district-heating, industrial and coupled-energy capacity and operating scenarios. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
